key.name: panel-mode
key.description: Where to place the Now Playing card: 'panel' (Top Bar / Dash to Panel) or 'bottom-bar' (standalone floating bottom pill).

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Horizontal box alignment in the bar: 'left', 'center', or 'right'.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Insertion index inside the selected Main.panel box.

key.name: bottom-margin
key.description: Distance in pixels from the bottom screen edge in standalone bottom-bar mode.

key.name: bar-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the song title and artist label in the bar.

key.name: bar-max-width
key.description: Maximum width in pixels for the track title and artist label in the bar.

key.name: scrolling-text
key.description: Smoothly scroll overflowing song titles horizontally instead of ellipsizing.

key.name: animate-track-resize
key.summary: Animate bar width on track change
key.description: Smoothly ease the bar card width and fade the track label when switching songs.

key.name: bar-icon-mode
key.description: What visual thumbnail to show in the bar card: 'app-logo', 'cover-art', or 'both'.

key.name: bar-text-format
key.description: Formatting of track metadata in the bar: 'title-artist', 'artist-title', or 'title-only'.

key.name: controls-position
key.description: Whether inline controls are visible ('right' / 'left') or hidden ('hidden'). Element order is controlled by bar-elements-order.

key.name: bar-elements-order
key.description: Ordered list of elements displayed in the bar card: 'app-logo', 'spectrum', 'title', and 'controls'.

key.name: controls-only-when-playing
key.summary: Show inline controls only while playing
key.description: Hide inline media control buttons in the bar when playback is paused or stopped.

key.name: hide-when-paused
key.description: Hide the entire widget whenever playback is paused or stopped, even if the media app stays open.

key.name: hide-when-inactive
key.summary: Hide widget when no media player is active
key.description: Hide the widget when there are no active or eligible MPRIS media players.

key.name: app-icon-white
key.description: Render the playing application icon in monochrome white instead of full color.

key.name: logo-click-raises
key.description: Focus and raise the playing application window when clicking its logo in the bar.

key.name: toggle-popup-shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to open or close the Now Playing popout card.

key.name: popup-blur
key.description: Render a blurred, saturated, darkened cover-art backdrop inside the Now Playing popup.

key.name: accent-source
key.description: Where to derive the accent color: 'cover' (song cover art), 'app-logo' (playing app icon), 'shell' (GNOME Shell accent), or 'white' (default white).

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width in pixels of the expanded Now Playing popout card.

key.name: popup-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the popout card backdrop and glass background.

key.name: show-shuffle-repeat
key.description: Display Shuffle and Repeat buttons in the popout when supported by the MPRIS player.

key.name: show-seek-buttons
key.description: Display quick 10-second backward and forward seek buttons in the popout.

key.name: show-volume-output
key.summary: Show volume slider and audio output switcher
key.description: Display volume control and audio output device selector inside the popout.

key.name: show-lyrics
key.summary: Enable live synced lyrics in popout
key.description: Display a collapsible synced lyrics button and panel inside the popout card.

key.name: show-popup-spectrum
key.description: Display a wide live audio spectrum graphic inside the expanded Now Playing popout card.

key.name: popup-spectrum-style
key.description: Visual style used for the wide spectrum visualizer inside the popout card.

key.name: show-popup-top-spectrum
key.summary: Show top bars spectrum above popout window
key.description: Display a bars-only live audio spectrum sitting along the top edge above the Now Playing popout card.

key.name: show-spectrum
key.description: Display the audio spectrum graphic next to the app icon.

key.name: spectrum-style
key.description: Visual style of the bar spectrum: 'bars', 'center-bars', 'wave', 'aurora', 'line', 'soundwave', 'dots', 'mirror', 'segments', 'matrix', 'ribbon', 'ring', 'pulse', or 'history'.

key.name: spectrum-colors
key.description: Color palette for the bar spectrum: 'accent' (follows accent/theme), 'classic' (red peaks), 'level' (green/yellow/red), or 'rainbow'.

key.name: accent-apply-spectrum
key.summary: Apply accent color to spectrum graphic
key.description: Tint the bar spectrum graphic with the selected accent color.

key.name: spectrum-columns
key.description: Number of vertical frequency columns displayed for bar, dot, mirror, and segment styles.

key.name: spectrum-width
key.description: Fixed pixel width for the panel spectrum across all visual styles (0 calculates width automatically from font size and columns).

key.name: spectrum-range
key.description: Effective dB range above the noise floor mapped to full bar height (lower values boost quieter tracks).

key.name: spectrum-peaks
key.description: Draw falling peak markers above active spectrum columns.

key.name: spectrum-all-sound
key.description: Keep capturing and displaying system audio even when playback is paused or no MPRIS player is active.

key.name: spectrum-fps
key.description: Target redraw rate in frames per second for the live spectrum visualizer.

key.name: spectrum-invert
key.description: Mirror frequencies horizontally so high frequencies appear on the left and bass on the right.

key.name: spectrum-demo-animation
key.description: Run a smooth simulated fallback animation whenever live audio capture receives silence (useful in VMs without audio passthrough).

key.name: hide-all-browsers
key.description: Ignore all web browser MPRIS sources and show only dedicated desktop media applications.

key.name: browser-youtube-only
key.summary: Only show browser playback when playing YouTube
key.description: When enabled, browser MPRIS sources are ignored unless the active browser playback comes from YouTube.

key.name: include-youtube-music
key.summary: Include YouTube Music in YouTube filter
key.description: Treat music.youtube.com tabs as valid YouTube sources when the YouTube-only filter is enabled.

key.name: ignored-players
key.description: Comma-separated list of player names or MPRIS bus names to ignore completely.

key.name: priority-players
key.description: Comma-separated list of preferred player names or MPRIS bus names prioritized first.
